known_differences: Native Stitch screens extrapolate unverified product and enterprise details; current official public HTML, CSS and media are used for the hosted draft instead.

Astro hydration, analytics and consent scripts were removed for static hosting; a small mobile navigation disclosure was implemented from observed official menu labels and destinations. Editor demos, tabs, animations, newsletter and other dynamic behavior remain unverified.

All 282 dated public assets were captured with provenance. To stay within the host build limit, the published draft packages only lightweight official CSS, fonts, SVGs and WebP images; larger official PNG/JPEG images and video load from Sanity public CDN.
Rendered side-by-side desktop/mobile comparison with the official website remains pending; exact visual parity is unverified.
